project.name: Flouss public landing
stack: CSS product stage and view-timeline reveals

motion.hero: Two-part word-animated headline and CSS iPhone mockup with scroll-linked blur-to-sharp reveal
motion.fallback: Reduced-motion mode shows final content without reveal animation

patterns: Static product stage with localized mockup labels

must: Arabic is the default locale and uses RTL layout
Meet WCAG AA text contrast in both themes
Respect reduced motion and keep the hero visual static
Keep all landing implementation files inside /landing and /qa/feat-landing
avoid: Unverified product, security, or privacy promises
Remote imagery and unnecessary external dependencies

decisions: Use the language-neutral coin-ring symbol and localize the wordmark by locale.
Use flat neutral surfaces, a soft gray hero stage, black pill calls to action, and scroll-linked blur-to-sharp reveals.
Use an Instrument Serif italic headline tail in French and English; Arabic uses a muted heavier-weight tail with normal tracking.
